review_evidence: Declaration grep over all 774 files: 749 files contain declarations (19,780 declaration lines in total); 25 files have zero.

The 25 zero-declaration files are aggregators such as QuantumAlg/Primitives/AmplitudeAmplification.lean (296 bytes, two public imports), QuantumAlg/Primitives/QKernel.lean (1389 bytes, six public imports plus a docstring naming the re-exported results and an empty section/end), and QuantumAlg/Primitives/MAU/Inversion/MK.lean (1155 bytes, thirteen import all lines, docstring, empty section/end). All three read completely.
A grep for open/export/notation/attribute/set_option/#eval/#check/#guard/variable/macro/syntax found zero such commands in the 25 aggregators; FILTER-007 still keeps them primary-eligible.

Files with an initial zero count under a narrower regex (for example QuantumAlg/Primitives/ZReset/Resources.lean, ZReset/Circuit.lean, Communication.lean, MAU/Division/Endpoint.lean) use `public def`/`public structure` declarations and hold real content (e.g. Communication.lean defines `public structure CommunicationProfile`).

Largest files QuantumAlg/Primitives/MAU/Inversion/MK/AuxiliaryShift.lean (627,120 bytes, 474 theorem/lemma lines) and MAU/Inversion/MK/DataPath/Coefficient.lean (606,854 bytes, 505 theorem/lemma lines) inspected at their heads: hand-written defs with docstrings citing sources, not generated data.
summary: Surveyed all 774 listed .lean files under QuantumAlg/Primitives (15,145,567 bytes total; 251 to 627,120 bytes each). A line-start declaration grep (theorem|lemma|def|structure|class|instance|inductive|abbrev|example|axiom|opaque, allowing public/private/noncomputable/meta modifiers and attributes) found 19,780 declaration lines, and zero in only 25 files. Those 25 are module aggregators: module header, (public) import / import all lines, module docstrings, and in some cases an empty section...end block. Under FILTER-007 they stay primary-eligible (ranked as navigation-import-only), because no verified auxiliary query path for them was established. The largest files are hand-written Lean with docstrings and hundreds of theorems each, not generated data. Every file stays searchable; rules is empty.
